summary: Aclaris Therapeutics filed an 8-K on August 6, 2026, to disclose entry into a Second Amended and Restated Sales Agreement with Leerink Partners and Cantor Fitzgerald for an at-the-market equity offering. The ATM program allows sales of common stock up to future amounts at the company's discretion, under a Form S-3 shelf. Leerink and Cantor act as sales agents, earning a 3.0% commission. No shares are sold yet; this is a routine capital-raising facility, not a special situation. Watch for future ATM sales, which would dilute existing holders.
